minecraft_cherry_leaves.description: Loose cluster of pink square petal flakes drifting slowly; seen at all three ticks in front and threequarter views, floating high at t3-t8 and sinking near the ground at t20. Top view shows a few large flat pink flakes at t3 and many large pink flakes spread across the field at t20; none visible in top t8.
minecraft_cherry_leaves.notes: Top t8 frame shows no pink flakes, likely drifted out of frame; the brown dirt chunks in top views are the persistent background debris.

minecraft_dripping_dripstone_water.description: A few tiny dark-blue square droplets high in the air at t3 and t8 in front and threequarter views; nothing at t20 in any angle. Top views show only the background dirt debris.
minecraft_dripping_dripstone_water.notes: Only a handful of specks; could be missed at a glance.

minecraft_egg_crack.description: Cluster of bright green four-pointed star/cross sparkles hovering in the air; densest at t3, still present at t8, reduced to one sparkle at t20. Visible in front and threequarter views; top views show only background dirt debris.
minecraft_egg_crack.notes: Pixels show green sparkles despite the shot name suggesting a neutral egg crack.

minecraft_falling_dripstone_water.description: A few tiny blue specks visible near ground level at t3 in front and threequarter views and near the dirt pile in top t3; nothing at t8 or t20 in any angle.
minecraft_falling_dripstone_water.notes: Only a few pixels at t3; may be partially occluded or already dissipated.

minecraft_flame.description: Cluster of small orange-yellow flame-shaped sprites in the air at t3 (~10 sprites), reduced to about two at t8, and completely gone by t20. Front and threequarter views only; top views show just the dirt debris.
minecraft_flame.notes: Distinctive flame sprite shapes; rapid burnout between t8 and t20.

minecraft_instant_effect.description: Small burst of pale white-cream x-shaped sparkle motes in the air at t3 only, in front and threequarter views; nothing at t8 or t20. Top views show only the dirt debris.
minecraft_instant_effect.notes: One-tick flash; easy to miss between captures.

minecraft_mycelium.description: Sparse dark brown/gray specks drifting slowly in the air: a small loose cluster at t3, two or three specks at t8, a single speck at t20. Front and threequarter views only; top views show only the dirt debris.
minecraft_mycelium.notes: Dark specks could be confused with the brown background debris, but they float in the sky well above the ground.

minecraft_sculk_charge.description: A single teal/dark-cyan rounded particle with a mottled interior, floating in the air at t3 in front and threequarter views; nothing at t8 or t20. Top views show only the dirt debris.
minecraft_sculk_charge.notes: Only one mote captured; the effect may be a single-particle pulse.

minecraft_soul.description: Small cluster of dark brown wisp-like motes with teal/cyan glowing flecks at t3 in front and threequarter views; one remaining mote with a cyan speck at t8 (threequarter), nothing at t20. Top views show only the dirt debris.
minecraft_soul.notes: Two-tone look (brown body + cyan flecks) is the most distinctive feature; brief lifetime.

minecraft_trial_spawner_detection_ominou.description: A few small teal/cyan square streaks descending in the air at t3 in front and threequarter views (~4 specks in front, ~2-3 in threequarter); nothing at t8 or t20. Top views show only the dirt debris.
minecraft_trial_spawner_detection_ominou.notes: Only captured at the earliest tick; brief falling streaks.

world_event_ANIMATION_DRAGON_SUMMON_ROAR.description: Every cell matches the empty baseline: flat grass and sky horizon with no particles. Top views contain only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile.
world_event_ANIMATION_DRAGON_SUMMON_ROAR.notes: Likely a sound or animation event that produces no visible particles at any captured tick.

world_event_PARTICLES_BEE_GROWTH.description: A few bright green four-pointed plus sparkles in the air: a small cluster of ~5 at t3 in front view, ~3 at t8, gone by t20; single sparkles in threequarter t3 and t8. Top views show only the dirt debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_BEE_GROWTH.notes: Distinct but very few sparkles; similar family to minecraft_egg_crack but sparser and shorter-lived.

world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_CHARGE.description: Every cell matches the empty baseline: flat grass and sky horizon with no particles. Top views contain only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile.
world_event_PARTICLES_SCULK_CHARGE.notes: The sibling shot minecraft_sculk_charge showed a single teal mote at t3 only, so this world event may emit a very short-lived particle that fell between capture ticks.

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.description: Dense burst of orange-yellow flame sprites mixed with black smoke flecks in the air at t3 (~15+ flames); about six scattered flame sprites remain at t8; nothing at t20. Front and threequarter views only; top views show just the dirt debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_SPAW.notes: The largest particle burst among the minecraft_*/world_event_* sheets in this batch.

superheroes_chaos_orb.description: Small clusters of pale yellow-white semi-transparent checkered/mosaic-looking quads hovering in the air at all three ticks in front and threequarter views, drifting slightly rightward over time. Top views show mostly the dirt debris, with a faint vertical streak at t8 and a few pale yellow translucent squares at the right edge at t20.
superheroes_chaos_orb.notes: The checkered texture reads like a partially transparent pattern; subtle and easy to miss against the sky.

superheroes_homelander_flight_landing.description: Massive one-shot burst of black and dark-gray square dust particles exploding upward and outward at t3, covering a large area in front and threequarter views and scattering dark flecks across the ground in top t3. Completely gone by t8 in every angle.
superheroes_homelander_flight_landing.notes: Dramatic burst present only at t3; top t3 shows the dark flecks spread over a wide ground area mixed with the background debris.

superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_2.description: Sparse cluster of tiny pale cream/white x-shaped sparkle specks in the air, drifting slightly: ~8-10 at t3, fewer at t8, one or two at t20 in front and threequarter views. Top views show only the dirt debris plus one pale speck at t20.
superheroes_kratos_hand_burst_2.notes: Very subtle; specks are only a few pixels each and could be overlooked.

superheroes_scorpion_harpoon.description: Every cell matches the empty baseline: flat grass and sky horizon with no particles. Top views contain only the persistent brown dirt-debris pile.
superheroes_scorpion_harpoon.notes: A projectile-style effect may have traveled outside the captured area or fired between ticks; nothing rendered in any frame.

superheroes_transform_spark.description: Cluster of bright cyan/light-blue four-pointed star sparkles in the air: ~8-10 at t3, a slightly smaller cluster at t8, one or two remaining at t20, drifting rightward. Visible in front and threequarter views; top views show only the dirt debris.
superheroes_transform_spark.notes: Distinct cyan star sparkles; the clearest of the superheroes_* bursts along with homelander_flight_landing.
